name: The Play's the Deadly Thing
summary: A travelling company plays in the inn's little theatre, and its villain dies before the curtain.

stages.journal: Hickock and Company have come to the Green Queen Inn to play The Prince in Gold. George Hickock wants us in the audience.
stages.hint: See the company at the inn.

stages.journal: Barnaby Quill, the company's villain, was found dead in his dressing room behind the stage, a cup beside him.
stages.hint: Question the company at the inn.

stages.journal: Everyone in the company has a reason. The prop cup and a torn letter may tell us more.
stages.hint: Examine the cup and the dead man's pockets, then speak to Lilian and Olwen.
objectives: Find the cup and the letter

stages.journal: Olwen Pike admitted it: Barnaby had ruined her old friend Mara. Hickock begs us to let the show go on.
The company has dealt with the dead man in its own way, and the Green Queen has seen its play.
